news.title: 让 AI 文本检测器适应不断变化的写作条件
news.body: MIT 与康奈尔研究人员通过测试时自适应，让检测器利用新的无标签数据调整模型，以应对写作变化和伪装文本。报道中的实验改善不代表检测已可靠到可单独用于认定学术不端。

papers.title: 用经典势与机器学习势比较氟化锂动力学和输运
papers.body: arXiv:2611.21900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We perform molecular dynamics simulations of molten Lithium Fluoride, comparing the classical Buckingham and Born-Huggins-Mayer potentials with machine-learnt interatomic potentials - the MACE-MP-0b3 (small) foundation model potential, and a fine-tuned version thereof. We find that the MACE-MP-0b3, out-of-the-box, is able to accurately reproduce the experimental shear viscosity across the liquid state comparable with polarisable potentials despite not itself being polarisable. Previous viscosities computed using classical potentials are under-predicted, which has previously been attributed to a suppressed melting temperature. Prompted by this w

papers.title: 机器学习原子间势的效率综述
papers.body: arXiv:2611.22444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) reach an accuracy close to quantum mechanical reference calculations at a small fraction of the cost. Efficiency is the purpose of MLIPs, yet strategies for efficient MLIPs have not been reviewed systematically. This review takes efficiency as its guideline. To compare MLIPs on a common footing, we represent them in a complete basis expansion, the Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) and its graph generalization (GRACE). The expansion is canonical, built from products of single-particle functions. Classical interatomic potentials, such as the embedded-atom method, and many modern MLIPs, including equiva
papers.summary: 预印本综述摘要：作者用 ACE 与 GRACE 展开统一讨论多种势函数，比较架构、非线性处理及精度与成本权衡。效率必须在给定精度和数据条件下衡量，不能据此认定某种架构普遍最优。

papers.title: ODAC25：可变形 MOF 气体吸附开放数据集
papers.body: arXiv:2508.03162v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Engineering economical and scalable processes for direct air capture (DAC) from humid air relies on atomistic modeling to search and identify promising sorbent materials from a vast chemical space. Machine learning has emerged as a powerful tool for predicting material properties in an efficient yet accurate manner, but these models require large sets of carefully curated training data. We present the Open DAC 2025 (ODAC25) dataset comprising nearly 60 million DFT single-point calculations for CO2, H2O, N2, and O2 adsorption in ~15,000 MOFs.
